newsitem.title: USA: India 97/8 soymeal exports near 2.6 MMT-US attache.
newsitem.headline: India 97/8 soymeal exports near 2.6 MMT-US attache.

text.p: A U.S. agricultural attache forecast India soybean meal exports in 1997/98 at nearly 2.6 million tonnes due to higher soybean production.

In a report dated May 29 and released in Washington on Tuesday, the attache pegged the 1997 India soybean crop at a record 4.4 million tonnes, saying a modest increase in soybean area was likely in 1997 in response to higher prices. That compares with estimated ouput of 4.1 million tonnes in 1996.
The attache forecast 1996/97 India soybean meal exports at 2.5 million tonnes, down slightly from a record 2.6 million tonnes in 1995/96.
Attache reports are not official USDA data. In its latest World Supply and Demand report on May 12, USDA pegged India 1996/97 soybean meal exports at 2.3 million tonnes.
